title: Sound Vanishes During Spacewalks

scenes.text: At 100 km above Earth, sound disappears in a vacuum.
People think astronauts hear nothing when walking outside the ISS.
scenes.label: Zero‑Sound Walk

scenes.text: In a vacuum sound cannot travel, but astronauts hear radio chatter and equipment noises transmitted through their suits.
scenes.label: Radio‑Only Sound

scenes.text: The silence you feel is just the vacuum; sound comes from your own suit and mission control.
scenes.label: Sound Source

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Spacewalks aren’t completely silent – the vacuum blocks air sound, but radio chatter keeps astronauts connected. Follow for daily science!
